aiOverview.content: Yes, Chuck Norris died on March 19, 2026, at the age of 86. His family announced his passing through a statement on his official Instagram account on March 20, 2026, describing it as a "sudden passing". Death Details Date of Death: Thursday, March 19, 2026. Location: He died in Kauai, Hawaii, shortly after being hospitalized for a medical emergency earlier that day. Final Moments: His family stated that he was "at peace" and surrounded by loved ones at the time of his passing. Recent Activity: Just nine days before his death, Norris celebrated his 86th birthday on March 10, posting a video of himself sparring and jokingly stating, "I don't age. I level up". Legacy and Career Chuck Norris was a legendary martial artist and six-time world karate champion before transitioning into a decades-long acting career. He was best known for his role in the television series Walker, Texas Ranger and numerous action films, including The Way of the Dragon, Lone Wolf McQuade, and The Delta Force. In his later years, he became a cultural icon through the widely popular "Chuck Norris Facts" internet memes that celebrated his perceived invincibility.
